name: github-graphql
title: GitHub GraphQL
summary: The GitHub GraphQL API on api.github.com/graphql: viewer, users, repositories with issues, pull requests and stargazers, search, rateLimit, and the createIssue and addComment mutations.

upstream.notes: GitHub's own public schema for github.com (about 1.5 MB, 309 operations) from the github/docs repository, pinned to its 2026-10-27 commit; github/docs is dual-licensed, CC-BY-4.0 for its data and content (this schema; attribution: GitHub) and MIT for code. It replaces octokit/graphql-schema (MIT), whose newest commit (597478f, 2025-02-27) declares EnterpriseOwnerInfo.repositoryDeployKeySetting twice and whose last loadable one (503d8f1, 2024-07-08) lacks Issue.issueType, blockedBy and blocking, which current `gh` queries. The subset keeps its type, field and argument names, so the scenarios' Query.rateLimit applies to both.

body.query: { viewer { login name } rateLimit { limit remaining } }
